verdict.rationale: incident.io ships multiple native AI-insight features directly in-product: Investigations auto-generates root-cause hypotheses from alerts, code, telemetry and past incidents (docs-14,16,23,31,56,62,66), Suggestions/summaries auto-draft incident updates and follow-ups (docs-12,53,54), and Insights dashboards offer trend/period comparisons (docs-18,32,64). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality and no customer testimonial specifically praising the AI insights (only general company adoption quotes exist).
